name: mateEquiv_square
statement: TwoSquare G₁ L₁ L₃ H₁) (β : TwoSquare H₁ L₂ L₄ K₁) (γ : TwoSquare G₂ L₃ L₅ H₂) (δ : TwoSquare H₂ L₄ L₆ K₂) : (mateEquiv (adj₁.comp adj₂) (adj₅.comp adj₆)) ((α ≫ᵥ β) ≫ₕ (γ ≫ᵥ δ)) = ((mateEquiv adj₂ adj₄ β) ≫ₕ (mateEquiv adj₁ adj₃ α)) ≫ᵥ ((mateEquiv adj₄ adj₆ δ) ≫ₕ (mateEquiv adj₃ adj₅ γ))

name: unit_conjugateEquiv
statement: L₂ ⟶ L₁) (c : C) : adj₁.unit.app _ ≫ (conjugateEquiv adj₁ adj₂ α).app _ = adj₂.unit.app c ≫ R₂.map (α.app _)

name: conjugateEquiv_comp
statement: L₂ ⟶ L₁) (β : L₃ ⟶ L₂) : conjugateEquiv adj₁ adj₂ α ≫ conjugateEquiv adj₂ adj₃ β = conjugateEquiv adj₁ adj₃ (β ≫ α)

name: mateEquiv_conjugateEquiv_vcomp
statement: A ⥤ B} {R₁ : B ⥤ A} {L₂ : C ⥤ D} {R₂ : D ⥤ C} {L₃ : C ⥤ D} {R₃ : D ⥤ C} (adj₁ : L₁ ⊣ R₁) (adj₂ : L₂ ⊣ R₂) (adj₃ : L₃ ⊣ R₃) (α : TwoSquare G L₁ L₂ H) (β : L₃ ⟶ L₂) : (mateEquiv adj₁ adj₃) (α.whiskerRight β) = (mateEquiv adj₁ adj₂ α).whiskerBottom (conjugateEquiv adj₂ adj₃ β)

have_tree.name: vcomp
have_tree.body: mateEquiv_vcomp adj₁ adj₂ adj₃ α (L₃.leftUnitor.hom ≫ β ≫ L₂.rightUnitor.inv)

name: conjugateEquiv_mateEquiv_vcomp
statement: A ⥤ B} {R₁ : B ⥤ A} {L₂ : A ⥤ B} {R₂ : B ⥤ A} {L₃ : C ⥤ D} {R₃ : D ⥤ C} (adj₁ : L₁ ⊣ R₁) (adj₂ : L₂ ⊣ R₂) (adj₃ : L₃ ⊣ R₃) (α : L₂ ⟶ L₁) (β : TwoSquare G L₂ L₃ H) : (mateEquiv adj₁ adj₃) (β.whiskerLeft α) = (mateEquiv adj₂ adj₃ β).whiskerTop (conjugateEquiv adj₁ adj₂ α)

have_tree.name: vcomp
have_tree.body: mateEquiv_vcomp adj₁ adj₂ adj₃ (L₂.leftUnitor.hom ≫ α ≫ L₁.rightUnitor.inv) β

name: conjugateEquiv_whiskerLeft
statement: B ⥤ C} {R₁ R₂ : C ⥤ B} {L : A ⥤ B} {R : B ⥤ A} (adj₁ : L₁ ⊣ R₁) (adj₂ : L₂ ⊣ R₂) (adj : L ⊣ R) (τ : L₂ ⟶ L₁) : conjugateEquiv (adj.comp adj₁) (adj.comp adj₂) (whiskerLeft L τ) = whiskerRight (conjugateEquiv adj₁ adj₂ τ) R
